expectation: I expect a shaped bowl or jar, though it may still need glazing and firing.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building up the bowl into a jar was the most worthwhile moment: the explanation made the transformation easy to picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the bowl at the kiln felt like an extra step after the jar had been fired directly.

surprise.text: The jar was glazed and fired in one combination without being placed at the kiln yard.

arbitrary.text: The different kiln requirements for the jar and bowl felt inconsistent, though both results were clear.

continue.text: I would probably try another chapter for more physical explanations like how the jar and tile were formed, though the inconsistent firing rules make me a little hesitant.
